subject: Fix timeouts to always be UTC (#68)
body:
This is true for the other timestamps in the table, and is pretty
confusing when running on systems that are not UTC.

This is potentially a breaking change for existing queues!

subject: Add a message priority (#65)
body:
This adds a priority field to the `goqite.Message`. Messages with higher
priority are received first.

This also changes the function signature for creating jobs, which now
takes a whole message, instead of just the message body. This enables
creating delayed jobs and jobs with different priorities.

Fixes #62

subject: Add Postgres support (#64)
body:
This change adds support for PostgreSQL as the underlying database. The
default is still SQLite (!), but this can be changed with the
`goqite.NewOpts.SQLFlavor` option.

Fixes #30
